scope: Acceptance follow-up of the original 41 Engine audit recommendations

corrections.behavior: Page URLs and owner-scoped recent-page storage preserve the active carousel page across reload, project reopening and browser Back/Forward. Deleted pages fall back safely. Editor Undo restores its page and selection without adding browser history entries or document saves.
corrections.browserVerification: Page 3 survives reload; Back/Forward switches between pages 3 and 2; Continue restores page 2; navigation does not enable Undo; deleting page 3 falls back to a valid page and Undo restores page 3; undoing a page-2 edit from page 3 restores page 2 and its selected shape.

corrections.behavior: Painting, pointer hit-testing and photo-frame targeting share the same order for interleaved and nested opacity groups.
corrections.verification: Regression coverage compares rendered markup with hit-test and photo-drop order, including hidden, transparent, zero-opacity and isolated artwork.

corrections.behavior: Pen and Hand do not expose or start selection transforms; changing tools cancels in-progress transformations. Select restores its controls and Nodes retains anchor editing.
corrections.browserVerification: A selected Circle exposes zero resize/rotation controls in Pen and Hand and restores all nine controls in Select.

corrections.behavior: Valid pending artwork with a corrupt baseline remains explicitly recoverable, without treating the damaged baseline as confirmed state for automatic merging.
corrections.verification: Native IndexedDB regression preserves the pending library, omits the invalid returned baseline and retains the stored original for recovery.

recoveryAcceptance.environment: Real Chrome/Chromium IndexedDB on a blank loopback origin, fresh isolated contexts, no application UI or user browser profile
recoveryAcceptance.strict: Fails when the browser or runner is missing; does not report skipped checks as success.

integratedValidation.browser: Page reload, gallery Continue, Back/Forward, deletion fallback, cross-page Undo and selection, and Select/Pen/Hand tool controls verified in the isolated local fixture.
